FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I get $VICINITY?

Four steps, about five minutes.

  1. Get a Solana wallet. Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, on your phone or in your browser. Write the recovery phrase down on paper and never share it.
  2. Add SOL. Buy SOL in the wallet app or on an exchange and send it to your wallet. Keep a little extra for network fees.
  3. Buy on Raydium. Use the Buy on Raydium button at the top of this page. It opens the official $VICINITY on Raydium LaunchLab (raydium.io); the contract address there must match the one here.
  4. Claim your spot. Connect here and set your home city. That starts your 7-day clock towards founding it, and your rank and badges go live.

The only real Raydium is raydium.io. Look-alike addresses copy it to empty wallets. Never type your recovery phrase into any website, and check any link with the checker above first.

Is this the only official $VICINITY?

Yes. Only the contract address at the top of this page is the official $VICINITY; anything else using the name is fake. If a token isn't on the official list, it isn't Vicinity: paste any link, token address or @handle into the checker to check it.

How is my rank worked out?

Straight from the blockchain: a wallet is compared with every holder, live, and the list is refreshed every minute. Pools and curves are listed but not ranked; team wallets are labeled. Paste any wallet address into the box above the holder list and press Check rank to see its rank, how much it holds and how far it is from the next spot. Nothing is saved.

What is the founder amount?

How much $VICINITY you hold towards founding your city: 100K to 1M by city size, held for 7 days. The rank check shows whether a wallet holds enough, or how much it still needs to reach the smallest amount.
